title: Ya-Sin 36:33-36 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 21 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:33-36 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 21. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ (٣٣) وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ (٣٤)

لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ (٣٥) سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ (٣٦)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:33-36 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:33-36 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 36:33-36 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.
Dead earth given life; grain; gardens of palms and grapes; springs; pairs in all creation.

questions.q: Link 36:36 to Year 10 biology: what 'pairs' do we know in plants?
questions.a: Male and female parts and plants; much is still being discovered (and what they do not know).

options: all things, from plants, people and what we do not know
questions.a: A) all things, from plants, people and what we do not know. 36:36: 'Exalted is He who created all pairs ...'

questions.q: Ya-Sin 36:33: «وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Allah points to dead earth brought to life, grain, palms and grapes (36:33 to 34). 'Will they not be grateful?' (36:35). What food did you eat today that shows this?
questions.a: Bread from grain, dates, fruit: none of it made by our hands alone; Allah grew it.
